narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services shows a concentrated federal contracting profile in FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services obligated $900M across 2 awards, with an average award size of $450M, and obligations are up 179868.7% year over year. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). Historical obligations were much smaller: FY21 was $251K, FY22 was $1.5M, FY23 was $655K, and FY25 was $500K. The largest NAICS market for FY2026 to date is Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing at $900M. The dataset mixes contract obligations and total contract values in award tables, and the overview reflects obligations unless otherwise noted. This profile reflects a single-year concentration of spending in one market and a sharp year-over-year jump in obligations compared with the prior fiscal periods.
